draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.62, the 220th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 17th of 21 at S. He went 236th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 44 tackles in 2019, 21st of 21 Ss in his class with stats.
